sbb21624e393189: The Red Hat High Central China CTO Zhang Jia-Cae brought "llm-d: Building Transload, Cross Model, Cross Hardware, Cross Platform Distributive Inference Plan."
sa220e43c67f35b: With the complexity of model size, type of request and hardware environment, it is difficult for a single Inference engine to solve all problems in the production environment independently.llm-d focuses on the control plane: capabilities such as smart routing, KV Cache management, Prefil/Decode separation, traffic control, automatic expansion and batch processing, allowing different Inference endpoints to work together around real time load and service objectives.
sc6b85b6e1c3543: In the direction of evolution in v0.8, llm-d further defines itself: instead of doing fork on the inference engine, it constructs an independent control layer around route, end selection, cache management and elasticity; and extends the scheduling capacity to Slurm, nudity metal and intensive learning training outside Kubernetes through mechanisms such as Endpoint Discovery.
